description: MCP server for Baozi prediction markets on Solana - 68 tools for AI agents

tool_signatures.name: build_add_to_race_whitelist_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to add user to race market whitelist.

tool_signatures.name: build_add_to_whitelist_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to add user to private market whitelist.

tool_signatures.name: build_batch_claim_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build single transaction to claim multiple positions at once.

tool_signatures.name: build_bet_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction for placing a bet on a boolean (YES/NO) market.

tool_signatures.name: build_cancel_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to cancel a boolean market. All bettors can claim refunds after cancellation. Only creator or admin can cancel.

tool_signatures.name: build_cancel_race_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to cancel a race market. All bettors can claim refunds after cancellation.

tool_signatures.name: build_change_council_vote_race_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction for council member to change their vote on a race market dispute.

tool_signatures.name: build_change_council_vote_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction for council member to change their vote on a boolean market dispute.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_affiliate_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to claim affiliate earnings.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_creator_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to claim accumulated creator fees from sol_treasury.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_race_refund_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to claim refund from cancelled race market.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_race_winnings_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to claim winnings from a resolved race market.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_refund_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to claim refund from cancelled/invalid market.

tool_signatures.name: build_claim_winnings_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to claim winnings from a resolved market.

tool_signatures.name: build_close_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to close betting on a market.

tool_signatures.name: build_close_race_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to close betting on a race market.

tool_signatures.name: build_create_creator_profile_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to create on-chain creator profile.

tool_signatures.name: build_create_lab_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to create a Lab (community) market. Validates against v7.2 rules. IMPORTANT: You MUST provide market_type and the corresponding timing field (event_time for Type A, measurement_start for Type B). Without these, creation will be BLOCKED.

tool_signatures.name: build_create_private_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to create a Private (invite-only) market.

tool_signatures.name: build_create_race_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to create a Race (multi-outcome) market with 2-10 outcomes.

tool_signatures.name: build_create_race_whitelist_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to create whitelist for private race market.

tool_signatures.name: build_extend_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: ADMIN ONLY: Build transaction to extend market deadline. Requires protocol admin signature.

tool_signatures.name: build_extend_race_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: ADMIN ONLY: Build transaction to extend race market deadline. Requires protocol admin signature.

tool_signatures.name: build_finalize_race_resolution_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to finalize race resolution.

tool_signatures.name: build_finalize_resolution_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to finalize resolution after dispute window.

tool_signatures.name: build_flag_dispute_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to challenge a proposed resolution with a bond.

tool_signatures.name: build_flag_race_dispute_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to dispute a race market resolution.

tool_signatures.name: build_propose_race_resolution_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to propose race market outcome.

tool_signatures.name: build_propose_resolution_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction for creator to propose market outcome.

tool_signatures.name: build_race_bet_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction for placing a bet on a race (multi-outcome) market.

tool_signatures.name: build_register_affiliate_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build unsigned transaction to register as an affiliate with a unique code.

tool_signatures.name: build_remove_from_race_whitelist_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to remove user from race whitelist.

tool_signatures.name: build_remove_from_whitelist_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to remove user from whitelist.

tool_signatures.name: build_resolve_market_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to directly resolve a market.

tool_signatures.name: build_resolve_race_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to directly resolve a race market.

tool_signatures.name: build_toggle_affiliate_transaction
tool_signatures.description: ADMIN ONLY: Build transaction to activate/deactivate affiliate. Requires protocol admin signature.

tool_signatures.name: build_update_creator_profile_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction to update creator profile. Both display_name and default_fee_bps are required.

tool_signatures.name: build_vote_council_race_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction for council to vote on race dispute.

tool_signatures.name: build_vote_council_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Build transaction for council member to vote on dispute.

tool_signatures.name: check_affiliate_code
tool_signatures.description: Check if an affiliate code is available for registration.

tool_signatures.name: format_affiliate_link
tool_signatures.description: Format an affiliate referral link for sharing.

tool_signatures.name: generate_invite_hash
tool_signatures.description: Generate a random invite hash for private market access control.

tool_signatures.name: generate_share_card
tool_signatures.description: Generate a share card image URL for a market. Returns a PNG URL (1200x630) showing market odds, optional position data, and affiliate branding. Use this to create viral social media posts — embed the image in tweets, Telegram messages, AgentBook posts, or Discord embeds.

tool_signatures.name: get_affiliate_info
tool_signatures.description: Get affiliate account info by code. Shows earnings, referrals, status.

tool_signatures.name: get_agent_network_stats
tool_signatures.description: Get overall AI agent affiliate network statistics.

tool_signatures.name: get_arena_leaderboard
tool_signatures.description: Get the current Agent Arena weekly leaderboard with calibration-based scoring. Shows top predictors ranked by composite score (calibration 40%, ROI 30%, volume 15%, consistency 15%).

tool_signatures.name: get_arena_season
tool_signatures.description: Get Agent Arena results for a specific past season by ID.

tool_signatures.name: get_claimable
tool_signatures.description: Get all claimable winnings and refunds for a wallet.

tool_signatures.name: get_commission_info
tool_signatures.description: Get affiliate commission structure and examples.

tool_signatures.name: get_creation_fees
tool_signatures.description: Get market creation fees for all layers (Official, Lab, Private).

tool_signatures.name: get_disputed_markets
tool_signatures.description: List all markets currently under dispute.

tool_signatures.name: get_intel_market_alpha
tool_signatures.description: Get cross-market alpha signals including correlation analysis, category skew, and alpha opportunities. Costs 0.003 SOL via x402 payment protocol.

tool_signatures.name: get_intel_resolution_forecast
tool_signatures.description: Get resolution forecast including closing time, tier, implied probability, and prediction. Costs 0.005 SOL via x402 payment protocol.

tool_signatures.name: get_intel_sentiment
tool_signatures.description: Get market sentiment analysis including comment sentiment, bet momentum, and pool trends. Costs 0.001 SOL via x402 payment protocol.

tool_signatures.name: get_intel_whale_moves
tool_signatures.description: Get whale position data for a market (positions > 1 SOL, whale sentiment split). Costs 0.002 SOL via x402 payment protocol.

tool_signatures.name: get_market
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific prediction market by public key.

tool_signatures.name: get_markets_awaiting_resolution
tool_signatures.description: List all closed markets awaiting resolution.

tool_signatures.name: get_my_affiliates
tool_signatures.description: Get all affiliate accounts owned by a wallet.

tool_signatures.name: get_parimutuel_rules
tool_signatures.description: Get v7.2 parimutuel rules for Lab market creation. CRITICAL: Read this BEFORE creating any market. Contains blocked terms, required data sources, and validation rules that will REJECT invalid markets.

tool_signatures.name: get_platform_fees
tool_signatures.description: Get platform fee rates for all layers.

tool_signatures.name: get_positions
tool_signatures.description: Get all betting positions for a wallet including win/loss stats.

tool_signatures.name: get_quote
tool_signatures.description: Calculate expected payout for a potential bet. Shows profit, fees, and new odds.

tool_signatures.name: get_race_market
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed info about a race market including all outcome labels, pools, and odds.

tool_signatures.name: get_race_quote
tool_signatures.description: Calculate expected payout for a race market bet on a specific outcome.

tool_signatures.name: get_referrals
tool_signatures.description: Get all users referred by an affiliate code.

tool_signatures.name: get_resolution_status
tool_signatures.description: Get resolution status for a market (resolved, disputed, pending).

tool_signatures.name: get_timing_rules
tool_signatures.description: Get v7.2 timing rules and constraints for market creation.

tool_signatures.name: list_markets
tool_signatures.description: List all Baozi prediction markets (boolean YES/NO) on Solana mainnet. Returns questions, odds, pools, status.

tool_signatures.name: list_race_markets
tool_signatures.description: List all race markets (multi-outcome prediction markets) on Solana mainnet.

tool_signatures.name: preview_create_market
tool_signatures.description: Preview market creation - validates params and shows costs WITHOUT building transaction. Use before build_create_market_transaction. IMPORTANT: For Lab markets, you MUST provide market_type and the corresponding timing field.

tool_signatures.name: simulate_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Simulate a transaction before signing to check for errors.

tool_signatures.name: submit_paper_trade
tool_signatures.description: Submit a paper (simulated) prediction to the Agent Arena. No SOL required. Scored on calibration accuracy when market resolves.

tool_signatures.name: suggest_affiliate_codes
tool_signatures.description: Generate suggested affiliate codes based on agent name.

tool_signatures.name: validate_bet
tool_signatures.description: Validate bet parameters before building transaction.

tool_signatures.name: validate_market_params
tool_signatures.description: Validate market parameters against v7.2 timing rules.

tool_signatures.name: validate_market_question
tool_signatures.description: Validate a market question against v7.2 rules BEFORE attempting to create it. Returns whether the question would be blocked and why. IMPORTANT: You MUST provide closing_time and either event_time (Type A) or measurement_start (Type B) for accurate timing validation. Without timing params, many invalid markets will pass.
